Implemented `std::filesystem::path` format types in `include/fmt/std.h`.

- `{:g}` formats `generic_string<Char>()`, producing slash-separated paths where applicable.
- Default formatting remains native.
- Debug formatting also respects `:g`.

cmake --build build --target std-test -j2
